import json
from pathlib import Path

def show_cells(path, patterns):
    nb = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    for i, cell in enumerate(nb.get("cells", [])):
        if cell.get("cell_type") != "code":
            continue
        src = "".join(cell.get("source", []))
        if any(p in src for p in patterns):
            print(f"=== {path} cell {i} ===")
            print(repr(src[:2000]))

'# loocv_categorical is imported from stamps.stats.evaluate.\n# It provides accuracy, balanced accuracy, MLL, Brier score,\n# confusion matrix and classification report in a single call.\n\nimport contextlib, io as _io\n\ndef _xgb_prior_fn(ck_te, cs_tr, ps_tr, feat_te, feat_tr, n_trials=0):\n    """Helper: fit XGBoostLSS per fold and return prior matrix.\n\n    XGBoostLSS always prints a \'Hyper-Parameter Optimization finished\' summary\n    regardless of the verbose/silence flags.  redirect_stdout swallows those\n    lines so they don\'t repeat once per LOOCV fold.\n    """\n    with warnings.catch_warnings(), contextlib.redirect_stdout(_io.StringIO()):\n        warnings.filterwarnings(\'ignore\')\n        ext, _ = BMEcatPrior(\n            ck=ck_te, cs=cs_tr, ps=ps_tr,\n            ck_features=feat_te, cs_features=feat_tr,\n            method=\'xgboostlss\', cv_config={\'n_trials\': n_trials},\n            categories=LITHO_CODES, verbose=False, return_details=True)\n    return ext'
